parameters.position_m: Independent componentwise bounds |dx_i|,|dy_i|<=p for each original hypothesis i.
parameters.mean_motion_relative: One constant shared n in [n0*(1-e),n0*(1+e)], e in [0,1].
parameters.queue_delay_s: Each realization has one known d in [0,D], zero commanded input on [0,d], then the fixed original pair command for one second. D in [0,1]. No observations distinguish the hypotheses during this schedule.
parameters.physical_calibration: None; parameters are mathematical sensitivity variables, not observed sensor errors.

claims: Every pair of full nominal-centered information boxes admits its original fixed command, while the full union is obstructed by the still-admitted nominal centers.
Every independently shifted triple within the boxes is initially admissible, admits the same original command for each pair, and has no common held command under the declared schedule.
positive_region: Closed original corridor, a sufficient subset of the original closed corridor/ellipse union. A failed sufficient bound is unresolved, never a proof of physical failure.
negative_region: Three proven necessary halfspaces containing the whole union, with fixed original rational weights. Coefficients and shifted right-hand sides bounded for every model/delay realization.

search.radius_units: Dimensionless rho multiplies the four SI/relative scales in their stated order.
search.algorithm: Evaluate rho0 and rho1. If cap passes, report cap only. Otherwise exactly14 rational bisection steps, treating every non-certificate as a failed sufficient bound. No optimized pair commands or replacement triple.
search.upper_interpretation: Smallest retained noncertified bracket is not a physical counterexample or an exact maximal radius.
search.strict_margin: Negative obstruction requires delta>0; closed positive margins may equal zero.

figure: Nominal-model p-v frontier of the explicit sufficient inequalities, with strict obstruction boundary excluded. Derived from the same recorded affine bounds, not additional trials.
stress_rule: A contrary witness must be inside its separately declared stress family, initially in the original region, and have a validated outside enclosure at an explicit time. It refutes that fixed command at that stress value only, not another control or the smaller certified neighborhood.

limits.retry: No started evaluation is silently retried. Preserve failed runs; numerical changes after run start require a new version. Fixed-output reproduction is labeled separately.

novelty: Application of established sufficient-margin and residual-checked infeasibility principles; no new general theorem or flight claim.
